items.exampleCN: 非合金钢更便宜但更软。

definition_zh: 暗指；间接提及；影射
definition_en: to mention something indirectly or briefly without saying it plainly
core_image: 说话绕了个弯，眼睛瞟向那件事
scene: 会议上经理没点名，只轻轻咳了一声。The manager alluded to the missed deadline.
sceneCN: 这里的 allude 是「暗指」（第 1 个义项：不明说而间接提及）；句意是经理暗指了错过的截止日期。

pos.zh: 暗指；间接提及（常与 to 连用）

derivatives.zh: 由 allude 加 -ion 构成，义为「暗指；典故」
由 allusion 加 -ive 构成，义为「暗指的；多典故的」
同根词（ludere 玩、躲），义为「躲避」
同根词（in- + ludere），义为「错觉；幻觉」

senses.title: To mention indirectly
senses.definition: to refer to something briefly and indirectly without naming it
senses.definitionCN: 不点名而简略间接地提及某事
senses.example: He alluded to their quarrel but never named her.
senses.exampleCN: 他暗示了那场争吵，却始终没提她的名字。
senses.why: The Latin root means "play with", so the word pictures toying around a subject instead of landing on it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根义为「戏耍」，词的画面是绕着话题打转而不点破。

senses.title: To hint at something discreditable
senses.definition: to hint tactfully at something embarrassing or shameful
senses.definitionCN: 委婉地暗示令人难堪或羞耻的事
senses.example: She alluded delicately to his debts.
senses.exampleCN: 她委婉地影射了他的债务。
senses.why: Indirection is safest around touchy subjects, the natural habitat of alluding.
senses.whyCN: 在敏感话题上迂回最安全，这正是暗指的天然场景。

senses.title: To make a literary or cultural reference
senses.definition: to evoke another text, myth, or cultural work without quoting it
senses.definitionCN: 不直接引用而唤起另一部作品、神话或文化典故
senses.example: The poem alludes to Dante's dark wood.
senses.exampleCN: 这首诗暗指但丁的幽暗森林。
senses.why: Literary allusion is indirection turned into an art form.
senses.whyCN: 文学用典是间接指涉的艺术化。

senses.title: To touch on a topic in passing
senses.definition: to touch briefly upon a topic within a larger discussion
senses.definitionCN: 在较大话题中顺带触及某题
senses.example: The lecture alluded to, but did not develop, the ethics question.
senses.exampleCN: 讲座触及但未展开伦理问题。
senses.why: A light touch, a brush past, fits the playful root.
senses.whyCN: 轻轻一掠、擦身而过，正合「戏耍」词根。

senses.title: To evoke through symbols or gesture
senses.definition: to suggest something through symbols, gestures, or settings rather than words
senses.definitionCN: 借象征、姿态或场景而非语言来暗示
senses.example: The film alludes to war through empty chairs.
senses.exampleCN: 影片以空椅子暗指战争。
senses.why: Symbols are the visual form of saying otherwise.
senses.whyCN: 象征是「换个说法」的视觉形式。

senses.title: To hint at shared knowledge
senses.definition: to invoke something both speaker and listener already know, without restating it
senses.definitionCN: 唤起说听双方已知之事而不复述
senses.example: They alluded to the old joke and burst out laughing.
senses.exampleCN: 他们暗示那个老笑话，随即大笑起来。
senses.why: Allusion works only inside a shared world; one word suffices.
senses.whyCN: 暗指只在共同世界里生效，一个词就够。

senses.title: To glide over a subject evasively
senses.definition: to skim a subject deliberately without committing oneself
senses.definitionCN: 刻意掠过话题而不表态
senses.example: The witness alluded to meetings but gave no dates.
senses.exampleCN: 证人提到开过会，却不给日期。
senses.why: Evasion is indirection serving self-protection.
senses.whyCN: 闪避是为自我保护服务的间接表达。

senses.title: Alluded to (passive): widely known by hints
senses.titleCN: 被动用法：尽人皆知却被讳言
senses.definition: in the passive, said to be the thing everyone hints at but no one states
senses.definitionCN: 被动语态中指人人暗示却无人明说之事
senses.example: The scandal, often alluded to, was never explained.
senses.exampleCN: 那桩丑闻常被暗示，却从未被解释。
senses.why: When many speakers circle a secret, the secret is "often alluded to".
senses.whyCN: 当众人围着秘密打转时，秘密便「常被暗指」。

intro.en: Allude comes from Latin alludere, "to play with, jest at", from ad- "toward" plus ludere "to play".
intro.cn: allude 源自拉丁语 alludere「戏耍、嘲弄」，由 ad-「朝向」加 ludere「玩」构成。

items.en: Root *leyd-, "to play", reconstructed.
items.cn: 重构词根 *leyd-「玩耍」。

items.en: ludere "to play"; alludere "to play with, jest at".
items.cn: 拉丁语 ludere「玩」；alludere「戏耍、嘲弄」。

items.en: alludere extended to "refer indirectly" in rhetorical use.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 alludere 在修辞用法中转为「间接提及」。

items.en: alluder or directly from Latin in learned use.
items.cn: 经法语 alluder 或学术拉丁语直接进入。

items.en: allude adopted in Renaissance literary English.
items.cn: allude 于文艺复兴时期进入英语文学用语。

items.en: Standard formal verb, usually with to.
items.cn: 标准的正式动词，通常与 to 连用。

note.en: Allude is often mixed up with elude and illusion from the same ludere root, and with refer in meaning.
note.cn: allude 常与同根的 elude、illusion 混淆，意义上与 refer 相近。

entries.definition: to escape cleverly; same ludere root, different prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 巧妙躲避；同 ludere 词根，前缀不同。

entries.definition: a false perception; in- + ludere, "to play upon".
entries.definitionCN: 错觉；in- + ludere「玩弄于」。

entries.definition: to deceive; de- + ludere, "to play falsely".
entries.definitionCN: 欺骗；de- + ludere「虚假地玩弄」。

entries.definition: to mention directly or explicitly; the plain counterpart.
entries.definitionCN: 直接明确提及；与暗指相对。

entries.definition: to suggest slightly; more everyday than allude.
entries.definitionCN: 略微暗示；比 allude 更日常。

entries.definition: to hint unpleasantly, often maliciously.
entries.definitionCN: 含贬义地旁敲侧击。

normalIntro.en: Anchor allude in the ludere play-family.
normalIntro.cn: 把 allude 锚定在 ludere 玩耍词族里。

normal.en: ad- + ludere: to play around a topic, not land on it.
normal.cn: ad- + ludere：绕着话题玩，不点破。

normal.en: Family: elude (escape), illusion (false play), delude (deceive), prelude (before-play).
normal.cn: 词族：elude（躲避）、illusion（错觉）、delude（欺骗）、prelude（前奏）。

normal.en: Noun allusion, adjective allusive, agent alluder.
normal.cn: 名词 allusion、形容词 allusive、施动 alluder。

normal.en: Grammar: allude is intransitive — always allude TO something.
normal.cn: 语法：allude 不及物——必须 allude to。

normal.en: Contrast: refer names it; allude circles it.
normal.cn: 对比：refer 点名，allude 绕圈。

abstract.en: A speaker's eyes slide sideways toward the thing nobody names.
abstract.cn: 说话人的眼角滑向那件无人点名的事。

abstract.en: A cat paws around a mousehole without going in.
abstract.cn: 猫围着鼠洞打转，却不钻进去。

abstract.en: Half a sentence, then a knowing smile.
abstract.cn: 半句话，然后一个心照不宣的微笑。

examples.en: She alluded to the accident but avoided details.
examples.cn: 她暗示了那场事故，但避而不谈细节。

examples.en: The essay alludes to classical myths throughout.
examples.cn: 这篇文章通篇暗用古典神话。

examples.en: Politicians often allude to problems without solving them.
examples.cn: 政客常影射问题而不解决问题。

sensesIntro.cn: 从绕题不点破出发，义项扩展到对难堪事的委婉影射、文学用典、顺带一提、象征暗示、共知默契、有意闪避，以及公开秘密的被动式。

core.cn: 核心意象：绕着目标转而不触碰

branches.en: Indirect and passing mention.

branches.en: Tactful hints at the discreditable.
branches.cn: 对难堪事的委婉影射。

branches.en: Literary and symbolic evocation.

branches.en: Shorthand among those who already know.

branches.en: Evasive skimming and the openly unspoken.
branches.cn: 闪烁掠过与公开的讳言。

intro.cn: allude 是干净的拉丁复合词：朝向 + 玩。

definition_zh: 暗指；间接提及；典故；引喻
definition_en: an indirect or passing reference to something, especially a literary or cultural work
core_image: 半句话点到为止，听者心里已经明白
scene: 演讲者只提了一句那次著名的远征。Her speech made an allusion to a famous voyage.
sceneCN: 这里的 allusion 是「暗指、引喻」（第 1 个义项：不点名的间接提及）；句意是她的演讲暗引了一次著名的远航。

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「暗指；间接提及」
由 allusion 加 -ive 构成，义为「暗指的；多用典故的」
形近同根词，义为「错觉；幻象」

senses.title: An indirect reference
senses.definition: a brief or passing reference made without naming its subject directly
senses.definitionCN: 不直接点名而简略提及的表述
senses.example: The essay makes an allusion to an old scandal.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章影射了一桩旧丑闻。
senses.why: From alludere "to play with": the words toy around the thing instead of seizing it.
senses.whyCN: 源于 alludere「戏耍」：言语绕着目标打转而不直接抓住它。

senses.title: A literary or cultural reference
senses.definition: a reference to another text, myth, artwork, or historical event embedded in a work
senses.definitionCN: 作品中嵌入的对另一文本、神话、艺术作品或史实的指涉
senses.example: The novel is dense with biblical allusion.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说充满圣经典故。
senses.why: Indirection becomes art when a whole story is summoned by a phrase.
senses.whyCN: 当一句话唤起整个故事时，间接指涉便成了艺术。

senses.title: A tactful hint at the unmentionable
senses.titleCN: 对难言之事的委婉影射
senses.definition: a delicate reference to something embarrassing, secret, or taboo
senses.definitionCN: 对难堪、隐秘或禁忌之事的婉转提及
senses.example: Her remarks contained a sly allusion to his past.
senses.exampleCN: 她的话里暗藏对他过去的狡黠影射。
senses.why: Subjects too risky to name survive only by allusion.
senses.whyCN: 不能明说的话题只能以暗指的方式存活。

senses.title: An allusion as the act of alluding
senses.definition: the act or practice of alluding
senses.definitionCN: 进行暗指的行为或做法
senses.example: Constant allusion made the speech hard to follow.
senses.exampleCN: 不断的用典让演讲难以跟上。
senses.why: The noun can name the practice, not only one instance.
senses.whyCN: 名词既可指一次实例，也可指这种做法本身。

senses.title: A false impression (illusion, cross-sense)
senses.titleCN: 与 illusion 混用的误例
senses.definition: in confused usage, a mistaken sense belonging to illusion, "a false perception"
senses.definitionCN: 混淆用法中误承 illusion 的义，「错误感知」
senses.example: Careful writers keep allusion apart from illusion.
senses.exampleCN: 严谨的作者把 allusion 与 illusion 区分开。
senses.why: The two words share a root in ludere and are commonly swapped in error.
senses.whyCN: 两词同出 ludere 词根，常被误换。

senses.title: A shared shorthand between intimates
senses.definition: a reference understood only by those who share the background
senses.definitionCN: 只有共享背景的人才能领会的指涉
senses.example: Their letters are full of private allusions.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的通信里满是私人暗语。
senses.why: Allusion works inside a closed circle of knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 暗指只在封闭的知识圈子里生效。

senses.title: A source acknowledged indirectly
senses.definition: a passing reference acknowledging a source or predecessor without formal citation
senses.definitionCN: 不正式标注而顺带提及来源或前人
senses.example: The thesis contains a quiet allusion to earlier research.
senses.exampleCN: 论文中含蓄地提及了更早的研究。
senses.why: Scholarly courtesy can be paid with a light touch.
senses.whyCN: 学术上的致意也可以轻轻一笔完成。

senses.title: Allusions collectively as texture
senses.titleCN: 作为整体质地的典故层
senses.definition: allusions considered collectively as the woven texture of a work
senses.definitionCN: 作为作品编织质地的典故总体
senses.example: The poem's allusion gives it its depth.
senses.exampleCN: 这首诗的典故层赋予它深度。
senses.why: Many small references aggregate into a stylistic fabric.
senses.whyCN: 无数细小的指涉汇成风格的整体织物。

intro.en: Allusion is allude plus the noun suffix -ion, from Latin allusio, "a playing with".

items.en: Root *leyd-, "to play".

items.en: ludere "to play" + ad- "toward" gave alludere.

items.en: allusio, "a playing with, a reference".

entries.definition: a false perception; same ludere root, different prefix; endlessly confused in writing.

entries.definition: the rare noun from elude, "escape".

entries.definition: a fixed false belief; from delude.

entries.definition: a direct, word-for-word borrowing; the opposite of indirect.

entries.definition: a mention, direct or indirect; the neutral umbrella term.
entries.definitionCN: 提及，直接间接皆可；中性统称。

entries.definition: an unpleasant insinuation; allusion with malice.
entries.definitionCN: 含贬义的旁敲侧击；带恶意的暗指。

normalIntro.en: Pin allusion to allude and split it from illusion.
normalIntro.cn: 把 allusion 锚在 allude 上，并与 illusion 划清界限。

normal.en: allude → allusion, as conclude → conclusion.

normal.en: al-lude plays toward a thing; il-lusion plays upon the eye.
normal.cn: allude 朝物「戏言」，illusion 在眼上「玩把戏」。

normal.en: Spelling trap: allusion (reference) vs illusion (false sight).
normal.cn: 拼写陷阱：allusion（暗指）与 illusion（幻象）。

normal.en: Adjective allusive: an allusive style is thick with references.
normal.cn: 形容词 allusive：allusive 风格即典故密集的风格。

normal.en: Fixed phrase: make an allusion to something.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：make an allusion to。

abstract.en: A raised eyebrow in place of a name.
abstract.cn: 扬起的眉毛代替一个名字。

abstract.en: One bar of a famous melody hummed in passing.
abstract.cn: 随口哼出名曲的一个小节。

abstract.en: A half-drawn map that only old friends can finish.
abstract.cn: 半张只有老友能补全的地图。

examples.en: The title is an allusion to Homer.
examples.cn: 标题暗引了荷马。

examples.en: He avoided any allusion to the lawsuit.
examples.cn: 他对那场官司避而不提。

examples.en: Her poems are woven with classical allusions.
examples.cn: 她的诗织满古典典故。

branches.en: The single reference and the habit of making them.

definition_zh: 年鉴；历书；年历
definition_en: an annual publication containing calendar, weather, astronomical, and miscellaneous useful information
core_image: 一本翻旧了的年度小册子：节气、潮汐、黄历俱全
scene: 农夫在灯下翻看一本小册子。The farmer checked the almanac for planting days.
sceneCN: 这里的 almanac 是「历书」（第 1 个义项：含历法与实用信息的年度出版物）；句意是农夫查历书选播种的日子。

derivatives.zh: 旧式拼法，与 almanac 同义
近义同域词，义为「日历；历法」，范围较窄

senses.title: An annual calendar of useful information
senses.titleCN: 含实用信息的年度历书
senses.definition: a yearly book with calendar days, seasons, tides, and astronomical data
senses.definitionCN: 收录历日、节气、潮汐与天文数据的年度册子
senses.example: The almanac predicted frosts in early May.
senses.exampleCN: 历书预测五月初有霜冻。
senses.why: The core image is one small book holding the year: dates, skies, tides.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一小本书装下一年：日期、天象、潮汐。

senses.title: A collection of miscellaneous facts and statistics
senses.titleCN: 杂集事实与统计的年鉴
senses.definition: an annual reference collecting facts, figures, and records across fields
senses.definitionCN: 年度出版的、汇集各领域事实数据与纪录的工具书
senses.example: She looked up the election results in an almanac.
senses.exampleCN: 她在年鉴里查选举结果。
senses.why: From sky-data the word widened to any handy annual compendium.
senses.whyCN: 由天象数据扩及一切方便好用的年度汇编。

senses.title: A farmers' weather and planting guide
senses.definition: an almanac used chiefly for weather lore and planting times
senses.definitionCN: 主要用于气象谚语与播种时机的历书
senses.example: Old farmers still trust the almanac more than forecasts.
senses.exampleCN: 老农仍更信历书而非天气预报。
senses.why: Farmers were the classic users of calendars of skies and seasons.
senses.whyCN: 农民是天象节气历书的经典使用者。

senses.title: An astronomical ephemeris
senses.definition: a technical annual of positions of celestial bodies
senses.definitionCN: 记录天体位置的年度专业历书
senses.example: Navigators plotted their route from the astronomical almanac.
senses.exampleCN: 领航员依据天文年历规划航线。
senses.why: The scientific core from which the popular almanac grew.
senses.whyCN: 这是通俗历书生长出来的科学内核。

senses.title: An astrological forecast book
senses.definition: an almanac containing astrological predictions for the year
senses.definitionCN: 载有全年占星预测的历书
senses.example: In the 1500s every almanac carried prophecies.
senses.exampleCN: 十六世纪每本历书都载有预言。
senses.why: Before science split from astrology, sky-books predicted fates too.
senses.whyCN: 科学尚未与占星分家时，天书也预言命运。

senses.title: A sports or topical annual
senses.definition: an annual of records and facts for a sport or subject
senses.definitionCN: 某一运动或专题的年度纪录与事实汇编
senses.example: Baseball fans quote the almanac like scripture.
senses.exampleCN: 棒球迷引用年鉴如引经据典。
senses.why: Any field with yearly records can host an "almanac".
senses.whyCN: 任何有年度纪录的领域都可以有自己的「年鉴」。

senses.title: A periodical of literary pieces
senses.definition: a literary annual or gift-book published yearly
senses.definitionCN: 每年出版的文学年刊或礼品书
senses.example: Victorian drawing rooms displayed literary almanacs.
senses.exampleCN: 维多利亚时代的客厅陈列文学年刊。
senses.why: The yearly format lent itself to anthologies and gift books.
senses.whyCN: 年度形式适合选集与礼品书。

senses.title: Figurative: a record of a life or era
senses.titleCN: 喻指人生或时代的记录
senses.definition: used figuratively for any running record of years and events
senses.definitionCN: 喻指对岁月与事件的连续记录
senses.example: Her letters are an almanac of the war years.
senses.exampleCN: 她的书信是战争年月的编年记录。
senses.why: A book that logs each year becomes a metaphor for memory itself.
senses.whyCN: 逐年记录的书成为记忆本身的隐喻。

intro.en: The origin of almanac is uncertain; medieval Latin almanach and Arabic al-manakh are leading candidates.
intro.cn: almanac 的来源不确定；中世纪拉丁语 almanach 与阿拉伯语 al-manakh 是主要候选。

items.en: al-manakh, "the climate, the calendar", one common hypothesis.
items.cn: 阿拉伯语 al-manakh「气候；历法」，是常见假说之一。

items.en: almenichiaka, a Coptic-Greek astronomical table title, another hypothesis.
items.cn: 希腊-科普特天文书 almenichiaka，另一种假说。

items.en: almanach attested by the thirteenth century for astronomical tables.
items.cn: 十三世纪中世纪拉丁语 almanach 已指天文表。

items.en: almanach borrowed into French with the same sense.
items.cn: 古法语 almanach 同义借用。

items.en: almanaque in Chaucer's time for astrological tables.
items.cn: 乔叟时代 almanaque 指占星历表。

items.en: From sky tables to the general annual reference of today.
items.cn: 从天象表发展为今天的通用年度工具书。

note.en: Almanac sits near calendar, yearbook, and annual in meaning; its own origin is famously uncertain.
note.cn: almanac 在意义上接近 calendar、yearbook、annual；其自身词源则以存疑著称。

entries.definition: a nut; shares the al- opening, unrelated origin.
entries.definitionCN: 杏仁；同以 al- 开头，词源无关。

entries.definition: an older or British variant spelling of almanac.
entries.definitionCN: almanac 的旧式或英式变体拼写。

entries.definition: a handcuff; letters overlap with the second half, unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 镣铐；与后半字母重叠，毫无关联。

entries.definition: a system or chart of days; narrower than an almanac.
entries.definitionCN: 历法或日历；比历书窄。

entries.definition: an annual of records, often of a school or field.
entries.definitionCN: 年度纪录汇编，多为学校或某领域。

entries.definition: any yearly publication, general term.
entries.definitionCN: 任何年度出版物，泛称。

normalIntro.en: Remember almanac through its Arabic article and its yearly job.
normalIntro.cn: 通过阿拉伯语冠词与年度职能记住 almanac。

normal.en: al- + manakh "the climate": a book of skies and seasons.
normal.cn: al- + manakh「气候」：记载天象节气的书。

normal.en: The al- is the Arabic article, like in algebra and alchemy.
normal.cn: al- 是阿拉伯语冠词，同 algebra、alchemy。

normal.en: One book, one year: dates, tides, stars, planting days.
normal.cn: 一本书管一年：日期、潮汐、星辰、农时。

normal.en: Benjamin Franklin's Poor Richard's Almanack uses the old spelling.
normal.cn: 富兰克林《穷理查年鉴》用旧拼写 Almanack。

normal.en: Family: calendar (days), almanac (days + data), yearbook (records).
normal.cn: 词族：calendar（日）、almanac（日+数据）、yearbook（纪录）。

abstract.en: A lantern-lit farmer tracing a finger across moon phases.
abstract.cn: 灯下农夫指尖划过月相表。

abstract.en: A thick little book that swells by one year each December.
abstract.cn: 一本小厚书，每年十二月增厚一岁。

abstract.en: Tide tables curling at the edges of a sailor's pocket.
abstract.cn: 水手口袋里卷了边的潮汐表。

examples.en: The almanac lists every solar eclipse of the decade.
examples.cn: 这本年历列出了十年内所有日食。

examples.en: He planted onions when the almanac advised.
examples.cn: 他按历书的建议种下洋葱。

examples.en: A sports almanac from 1950 sold at auction.
examples.cn: 一本 1950 年的体育年鉴被拍卖。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one book holding the whole year
core.cn: 核心意象：一本书装下整个年份

branches.en: The calendar book and its astronomical core.
branches.cn: 历书本体与天文内核。

branches.en: General fact compendium and special-field annuals.

intro.cn: almanac 是单一借词，但其 al- 开头把它系于庞大的阿拉伯语词族。

latinIntro.en: The word traveled through Medieval Latin and Old French; deeper origin is uncertain.

definition_zh: 冷淡的；疏远的；超然离群的（副词：远离地；冷淡地）
definition_en: not friendly or forthcoming; distant and cool, or at a distance
core_image: 船头迎风站开、不靠人群的那个人
scene: 聚会上众人围坐说笑，他却站在窗边。She remained aloof from the gossip.
sceneCN: 这里的 aloof 是「疏远的、超然的」（第 1 个义项：有意保持距离的冷淡）；句意是她对那些闲话保持超然。

derivatives.zh: 由 aloof 加 -ness 构成，义为「冷淡；超然」
同源航海词，义为「船头」的旧称

senses.title: Cool and distant in manner
senses.definition: physically or emotionally distant in dealing with others
senses.definitionCN: 待人接物时保持身体或情感上的距离
senses.example: The new manager seemed aloof at first.
senses.exampleCN: 新经理起初显得很冷淡。
senses.why: From sailors keeping "to windward", apart; distance became coldness.
senses.whyCN: 源于水手「迎风在上风处」避开；距离引申为冷淡。

senses.title: Uninvolved in a matter
senses.definition: deliberately not taking part or taking sides
senses.definitionCN: 有意不参与、不站队
senses.example: He kept aloof from office politics.
senses.exampleCN: 他对办公室政治置身事外。
senses.why: Standing apart in space maps onto standing apart in affairs.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的站开映射到事务上的不沾手。

senses.title: Reserved out of shyness
senses.definition: withholding oneself because of shyness rather than contempt
senses.definitionCN: 因羞怯而非轻蔑而退缩不前
senses.example: Aloof in crowds, she opened up one on one.
senses.exampleCN: 她在人群中拘谨，一对一却很健谈。
senses.why: The same distance can spring from fear of exposure, not pride.
senses.whyCN: 同样的距离感可以源于怕暴露，而非傲慢。

senses.title: Superior and disdainful
senses.definition: distancing oneself from others as if beneath one's notice
senses.definitionCN: 视他人不值得注意而与之保持距离
senses.example: The professor was aloof toward undergraduates.
senses.exampleCN: 教授对本科生态度高傲。
senses.why: Distance read upward becomes disdain.
senses.whyCN: 距离一旦向上解读就成了轻蔑。

senses.title: Objectively detached, positively
senses.definition: neutrally detached in judgment, free of bias or faction
senses.definitionCN: 判断上中立超然，不受派系或偏见影响
senses.example: A referee must stay aloof from the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 裁判必须不为观众所动。
senses.why: Distance can be a virtue: the judge above the fray.
senses.whyCN: 距离也可以是美德：裁判立于纷争之上。

senses.title: Standing at a physical distance
senses.definition: as an adverb, standing or kept apart in space
senses.definitionCN: 作副词，指在空间上站开或保持距离
senses.example: The sentry called, "Stand aloof!"
senses.exampleCN: 哨兵喝道：「站开！」
senses.why: This is the original nautical sense before the emotional one.
senses.whyCN: 这是情感义之前的原始航海义。

senses.title: Guarded and unrevealing
senses.definition: guarded in speech, revealing little of oneself
senses.definitionCN: 言语谨慎，很少袒露自我
senses.example: He stayed aloof about his past.
senses.exampleCN: 他对自己的过去讳莫如深。
senses.why: Withholding words is a form of keeping distance.
senses.whyCN: 不吐露言语是保持距离的一种形式。

senses.title: Detached by temperament
senses.definition: having a naturally solitary, unsociable temperament
senses.definitionCN: 天性孤僻、不合群
senses.example: Cats are famously aloof.
senses.exampleCN: 猫以孤高著称。
senses.why: When distance becomes a character trait, the word describes nature, not mood.
senses.whyCN: 当距离成为性格，词就描述本性而非一时情绪。

intro.en: Aloof comes from the nautical phrase a-luff, "to windward", where a ship's head keeps clear.
intro.cn: aloof 源自航海短语 a-luff「迎风向上风处」，指船头保持清距。

items.en: lof or looch, "windward", the nautical term.
items.cn: 中古荷兰语 lof/looch「上风」，航海术语。

items.en: a loof, "to windward", used in sailing orders.
items.cn: 中古英语 a loof「向上风」，用于操船口令。

items.en: aloof as adverb, "at a distance, apart".
items.cn: 十六世纪 aloof 作副词「隔开、远离」。

items.en: The emotional sense "distant in manner" develops.
items.cn: 十七世纪发展出「态度疏远」的情感义。

items.en: Used by major writers for proud or shy detachment.
items.cn: 被重要作家用于写骄傲或羞怯的疏离。

items.en: Chiefly adjectival today; the adverb use is older-fashioned.
items.cn: 如今以形容词为主，副词用法较旧。

note.en: Aloof is distinct from aloft by one letter, and near in meaning to distant and reserved.
note.cn: aloof 与 aloft 仅差一个字母，意义上与 distant、reserved 相近。

entries.definition: up in the air; one letter apart, related nautical history but opposite direction.
entries.definitionCN: 在高处；仅差一字母，同有航海渊源但方向相反。

entries.definition: the Dutch nautical source of aloof.
entries.definitionCN: 荷兰语航海来源词。

entries.definition: an animal's foot; rhymes only.
entries.definitionCN: 蹄；仅押韵。

entries.definition: not intimate; broader, covering space and manner.
entries.definitionCN: 不亲近的；兼指空间与态度，更宽泛。

entries.definition: slow to show feelings; less cold than aloof.
entries.definitionCN: 不外露感情的；比 aloof 少冷意。

entries.definition: emotionally uninvolved, often neutrally.
entries.definitionCN: 情感上不介入的，常为中性。

normalIntro.en: Anchor aloof in the ship that keeps clear.
normalIntro.cn: 把 aloof 锚定在保持清距的船上。

normal.en: a + loof "to windward": a ship holding off, staying clear.
normal.cn: a + loof「上风」：船保持距离、不靠近。

normal.en: aloof vs aloft: up the mast is aloft; away from the crowd is aloof.
normal.cn: aloof 与 aloft：爬上桅杆是 aloft，避开人群是 aloof。

normal.en: Noun: aloofness; phrases: keep/stand/remain aloof from.
normal.cn: 名词 aloofness；短语 keep/stand/remain aloof from。

normal.en: Adjective or adverb: an aloof manner / stand aloof.
normal.cn: 可作形容词或副词：an aloof manner / stand aloof。

normal.en: Tone watch: aloof can blame (cold) or praise (impartial).
normal.cn: 语气注意：aloof 可贬（冷漠）可褒（超然）。

abstract.en: One chair pulled an arm's length back from the circle.
abstract.cn: 一把椅子被拉离人群一臂之遥。

abstract.en: A cat watching the party from the top of the bookshelf.
abstract.cn: 猫在书架顶上看派对。

abstract.en: A ship holding its bow into the wind, keeping a gap of gray water.
abstract.cn: 船顶着风，与人群隔开一线灰色的海。

examples.en: She stayed aloof during the quarrel.
examples.cn: 争吵期间她保持超然。

examples.en: His aloof manner hid deep shyness.
examples.cn: 他冷淡的举止掩盖了深深的羞怯。

examples.en: The judge kept aloof from the media frenzy.
examples.cn: 法官与媒体的狂热保持距离。

definition_zh: 改变；更改；（把衣服）改小或改大
definition_en: to change something, or to become different, often in a partial way
core_image: 裁缝把一条过长的裤脚卷起、重新缝好
scene: 裁缝量了量裤脚，说可以改短两厘米，明天就能取。The tailor altered the trousers to fit me.
sceneCN: 这里 alter 是「改（衣服）」（第 3 个义项：通过缝改使衣物合身）；句意是裁缝把裤子改得合我的身。

derivatives.zh: 名词：改动；修改
形容词：改变了的
形容词：可改变的
形容词：不可改变的
名词：替代方案，与 alter 同源

senses.title: To change something partly
senses.definition: to make something different, usually by changing part of it rather than replacing it entirely
senses.definitionCN: 使某物变得不同，通常是改动其中一部分，而不是整体替换
senses.example: The new evidence altered the course of the investigation.
senses.exampleCN: 新证据改变了调查的方向。
senses.why: The word comes from Latin alter, 'the other of two', so to alter is to make a thing other than it was, a shift rather than a total replacement.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自拉丁语 alter「两者中的另一个」，所以 alter 是让事物变成与原来不同的另一个样子，是转变而不是整体替换。

senses.title: To become different
senses.definition: to change by itself over time, used without an object
senses.definitionCN: 自身随时间发生变化，不带宾语
senses.example: Her expression altered when she heard the news.
senses.exampleCN: 听到这个消息，她的表情变了。
senses.why: Because the change can happen without an agent, the verb also works intransitively, describing a state that shifts rather than someone acting on it.
senses.whyCN: 因为变化可以在没有施动者的情况下发生，这个动词也可作不及物用法，描述状态自身发生转变。

senses.title: To adjust clothing
senses.definition: to take in or let out a garment so that it fits better
senses.definitionCN: 把衣服收小或放宽，使其更合身
senses.example: The tailor altered the trousers to fit me.
senses.exampleCN: 裁缝把裤子改得合我的身。
senses.why: Tailoring is change on a small scale: the garment stays the same object but its measurements are made other, which is exactly the Latin sense in daily use.
senses.whyCN: 裁缝做的就是小尺度改动：衣服还是那件衣服，只是尺寸被改成另一个样子，这正是 alter 的拉丁本义在日常中的体现。

intro.en: Alter goes back to a Latin word for 'the other of two', which explains why it means change rather than replace.
intro.cn: alter 可追溯到拉丁语「两者中的另一个」，这解释了它为何意为改变而非替换。

items.en: alter meant 'the other one of two', as in alter ego, a second self.
items.cn: alter 意为「两者中的另一个」，如 alter ego 指第二个自我。

items.en: The verb alterare meant 'to make other, to change'.
items.cn: 动词 alterare 意为「使成为另一个、改变」。

items.en: French passed the verb on as alterer, used for changing plans, words, or goods.
items.cn: 法语以 alterer 传下这个动词，用于改变计划、言辞或货物。

items.en: English alter appears in the fourteenth century with the sense 'to make different'.
items.cn: 英语 alter 在十四世纪出现，意为「使不同」。

items.en: The clothing sense grew from everyday tailoring, while alteration names any change made.
items.cn: 衣物义从日常裁缝发展而来，而 alteration 泛指任何改动。

note.en: The look-alike group separates the homophone altar; the near-meaning group grades kinds of change.
note.cn: 形近组区分同音词 altar；近义组按改动方式分级。

entries.definition: a table used in religious ceremonies
entries.definitionCN: 宗教仪式用的祭坛

entries.definition: completely or in total
entries.definitionCN: 完全；总共

entries.definition: a change made to something
entries.definitionCN: 改动

entries.definition: to make or become different
entries.definitionCN: 改变

entries.definition: to change something slightly to improve it
entries.definitionCN: 稍作修改

entries.definition: to change something to fit a new situation
entries.definitionCN: 调整

entries.definition: to change a text or law formally
entries.definitionCN: 正式修订

normalIntro.en: Alter means to make a thing into the other version of itself.
normalIntro.cn: alter 就是把事物变成它自己的另一个版本。

normal.en: Latin alter means the other of two.
normal.cn: 拉丁 alter 意为两者中的另一个。

normal.en: Alter ego is a second self, from the same root.
normal.cn: alter ego 是第二个自我，同出一源。

normal.en: Altar with an a at the end is the church table.
normal.cn: 结尾是 a 的 altar 是教堂里的祭坛。

normal.en: A tailor alters clothes, a planner alters plans.
normal.cn: 裁缝改衣服，计划者改计划。

normal.en: Stress the first syllable: AL-ter.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节：AL-ter。

abstract.en: Picture a hem being sewn a little higher.
abstract.cn: 想象裤脚被缝高了一点。

abstract.en: See a road bending away from its old line.
abstract.cn: 想象道路偏离原来的走向。

abstract.en: Watch a face change at a piece of news.
abstract.cn: 想象一张脸听到消息后变了神情。

examples.en: Nothing can alter the fact that the deadline has passed.
examples.cn: 截止日期已过，这个事实无法改变。

examples.en: The tailor altered the dress for the wedding.
examples.cn: 裁缝为婚礼改了这条裙子。

examples.en: His mood altered as soon as the rain stopped.
examples.cn: 雨一停，他的心情就变了。

sensesIntro.en: Making a thing other yields three uses: changing an object, changing by itself, and fitting clothes.
sensesIntro.cn: 「使成为另一个」生出三种用法：改动对象、自身变化、改衣服尺寸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hem unpicked and sewn again.

branches.en: trousers taken in at the waist

intro.en: A Latin verb whose root alter still appears in several English words.
intro.cn: 这是拉丁动词，其词根 alter 仍出现在若干英语词中。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base alter and its verb alterare are the source of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 alter 与动词 alterare 是整族词的来源。

definition_zh: 改变；改动；变更；修改；改做（衣服）；蚀变；变音
definition_en: the act or result of making something different in part, so that it remains recognisable, whether in appearance, structure, text, tissue, rock, or a musical note
core_image: 同一个人换了一件外套：还是他，但轮廓、颜色和旁人的第一眼都变了
scene: 裁缝把大衣的腰线收进去两厘米，肩线因此看起来更挺。The tailor takes in the waist of the coat by two centimetres, and that small alteration makes the shoulder line look sharper.
sceneCN: 这里 alteration 是「衣服改做」（第 3 个义项：按顾客尺寸修改成衣）；句意：裁缝把大衣腰线收进两厘米，这一小小的改做让肩线显得更挺。场景要点：试衣镜、别针、粉笔线、缝纫机、改衣单、挂在架上的大衣。

senses.title: The act of making something different
senses.titleCN: 使某物变得不同的动作
senses.definition: the act of changing something in some respect without replacing it
senses.definitionCN: 在某个方面改变某物而不替换它的动作
senses.example: Any alteration to the wiring must be inspected before the power is restored.
senses.exampleCN: 电线的任何改动都必须在恢复供电前接受检查。
senses.why: Alteration comes from alter, 'the other of two'. The act sets one state beside another and moves the thing toward the second, so the noun names the crossing, not a new creation.
senses.whyCN: alteration 出自 alter“两者中的另一个”。这个动作把一个状态摆在另一个状态旁边，并让事物朝第二个状态移动，所以名词命名的是“跨越”，而不是“造出新东西”。

senses.title: A change in appearance or character
senses.definition: a change in the character, appearance, or condition of something, recorded from the 1530s
senses.definitionCN: 某物在性质、外貌或状况上的变化，此义记录于 16 世纪 30 年代
senses.example: Neighbours noticed an alteration in the old house: shutters gone, roof retiled.
senses.exampleCN: 邻居们注意到那座老房子的变化：百叶窗没了，屋顶换了瓦。
senses.why: The -ation noun also names the result. What is left after the crossing is the thing itself, but now carrying the marks of the other state.
senses.whyCN: -ation 名词也命名结果。跨越之后留下的仍是那件东西本身，只是带上了另一个状态的痕迹。

senses.title: A garment taken in or let out
senses.definition: the work of adjusting a ready-made garment to a customer's measurements, a sense recorded from 1901
senses.definitionCN: 按顾客尺寸调整成衣的活儿，此义记录于 1901 年
senses.example: The alterations cost almost as much as the jacket itself.
senses.exampleCN: 改衣服的钱几乎和夹克本身一样多。
senses.why: Clothes are the most intimate thing that can be 'made other' while staying the same object. Tailoring turns the abstract act into a paid service with a plural noun.
senses.whyCN: 衣服是最贴身、又能在保持同一件物品的前提下被“做成另一个样子”的东西。裁缝业把这个抽象动作变成一项收费服务，并常用复数名词。

senses.title: A structural change to a building
senses.definition: a change to the fabric, layout, or fittings of a building
senses.definitionCN: 对建筑物的结构、布局或固定设施所作的改动
senses.example: The tenant made structural alterations without the owner's consent.
senses.exampleCN: 租户未经业主同意就做了结构改造。
senses.why: A building survives small changes; that is exactly what alteration means. Add a wall or move a door and the house is still the same house, but another version of it.
senses.whyCN: 建筑能在小改动后继续存在，这正是 alteration 的意思。加一堵墙或移一扇门，房子仍是同一座房子，但成了它的另一个版本。

senses.title: A change to a text or record
senses.definition: a change made to a document, manuscript, or record, often one that matters legally
senses.definitionCN: 对文件、手稿或记录所作的改动，通常指具有法律意义的改动
senses.example: The clerk found three alterations in the ledger, all in the same hand.
senses.exampleCN: 职员在账本里发现三处改动，笔迹都相同。
senses.why: Writing fixes a state so it can be compared later. An alteration is visible precisely because the earlier version left a trace, and that trace is what makes the change provable.
senses.whyCN: 书写把某个状态固定下来，以便日后比较。改动之所以可见，正是因为早先的版本留下了痕迹，而这条痕迹让改动可以被证明。

senses.title: A change in cells or body chemistry
senses.titleCN: 细胞或体内化学的改变
senses.definition: a change in the structure or activity of cells, tissue, or body chemistry
senses.definitionCN: 细胞、组织或体内化学的结构或活动发生变化
senses.example: Chronic stress produces lasting alterations in how the immune system responds.
senses.exampleCN: 长期压力会使免疫系统的反应方式发生持久改变。
senses.why: Living tissue is a state that can shift without becoming something else. Medicine uses the word for changes that are measurable but leave the organ identifiable.
senses.whyCN: 活组织是一种可以移动却不会变成他物的状态。医学用这个词指那些可测量、但仍让器官保持可辨识的改变。

senses.title: Rock reworked by heat, water, or pressure
senses.titleCN: 岩石受热、水或压力作用而蚀变
senses.definition: the chemical or mineral change of rock through heat, water, or pressure
senses.definitionCN: 岩石在热、水或压力作用下发生的化学或矿物变化
senses.example: Hydrothermal alteration turned the volcanic ash into a soft white clay.
senses.exampleCN: 热液蚀变把火山灰变成了柔软的白黏土。
senses.why: Geology needs a word for change in place: the rock is not replaced, it is reworked. The original minerals give way to others while the body of rock keeps its shape.
senses.whyCN: 地质学需要一个表示“在原地改变”的词：岩石不是被替换，而是被重新改造。原来的矿物让位给别的矿物，岩体却保持原来的形状。

senses.title: A change that affects legal validity
senses.definition: in law, a change to a document or term that is significant enough to affect rights or obligations
senses.definitionCN: 在法律上，对文件或条款作出的、足以影响权利或义务的变更
senses.example: A material alteration voids the cheque; a smudge does not.
senses.exampleCN: 实质性变更会使支票失效；一点污渍则不会。
senses.why: Law must separate change that matters from change that does not. Alteration becomes a threshold concept: the same word now measures whether the 'other' state has crossed into a legally different thing.
senses.whyCN: 法律必须把“要紧的改动”和“不要紧的改动”分开。alteration 于是成了一个门槛概念：同一个词现在衡量的是，那“另一个”状态是否已经跨进法律上不同的东西。

senses.title: A chromatic change to a note
senses.definition: in music, the raising or lowering of a note away from the prevailing key
senses.definitionCN: 在音乐中把某个音升高或降低，使其偏离当前调性
senses.example: The passage depends on an alteration of the fourth degree, which lifts the whole phrase.
senses.exampleCN: 这一乐段靠第四级的变音把整句托了起来。
senses.why: A note stays the same note but is moved to a neighbouring pitch. Music theory picked up the word for exactly that: another version of the same degree, not a new note.
senses.whyCN: 音符仍是同一个音符，只是被移到相邻的音高。音乐理论正是用这个词指这件事：同一音级的另一个版本，而不是一个新音符。

intro.en: Alteration is an action noun built in Latin and borrowed whole: alter 'the other of two' → alterare 'make other, change' → alteratio 'a changing' → English alteration. Its core is not addition but substitution of one state for another. The look-alike altar is a different word altogether, from Latin altare and influenced by altus 'high', not from alter.
intro.cn: alteration 是拉丁语中构成、整体借入的动作名词：alter“两者中的另一个”→ alterare“使成为另一个、改变”→ alteratio“改变”→ 英语 alteration。它的核心不是添加，而是用一个状态替换另一个。形近词 altar 完全是另一个词，来自拉丁语 altare，并受 altus“高”影响，不出自 alter。

items.en: First recorded as alteracioun, 'change, transformation, action of altering', from Old French alteracion (14c.) and directly from Medieval Latin alterationem (nominative alteratio).
items.cn: 最早记录为 alteracioun，意为“改变、转变、改动的动作”，来自古法语 alteracion（14 世纪），并直接来自中世纪拉丁语 alterationem（主格 alteratio）。

items.en: Alteratio is a noun of action from the past-participle stem of Late Latin alterare 'to change'. The -ation element is Latin -ationem, the same action-noun suffix as in aggregation and congregation.
items.cn: alteratio 是由晚期拉丁语 alterare“改变”的过去分词词干构成的动作名词。-ation 成分就是拉丁语 -ationem，与 aggregation、congregation 中的动作名词后缀相同。

items.en: Alterare comes from Latin alter 'the other (of the two)', reconstructed as PIE *al- 'beyond' plus the comparative suffix -ter, as in other. The root means 'the other one', not 'more'.
items.cn: alterare 出自拉丁语 alter“两者中的另一个”，可重构为原始印欧语 *al-“在……之外”加比较级后缀 -ter，如同 other。这个词根的意思是“另一个”，不是“更多”。

items.en: The *al- root also gives alien, alias, altruism and ultimate, and through a variant *an-tero- it gives English other. The comparative shape explains why alter always implies exactly two states to choose between.
items.cn: 这个 *al- 词根还给出 alien、alias、altruism、ultimate，并经变体 *an-tero- 给出英语 other。比较级形态解释了为什么 alter 总暗示恰好有两个状态可供选择。

items.en: The sense 'change in character or appearance' is recorded from the 1530s, and 'change in ready-made clothes to suit a customer' from 1901. Legal material alteration and geological alteration develop later as technical thresholds.
items.cn: “性质或外貌的变化”义记录于 16 世纪 30 年代，“按顾客要求修改成衣”义记录于 1901 年。法律的 material alteration 与地质的 alteration 后来才作为技术门槛发展出来。

items.en: Altar comes from Latin altare (perhaps originally 'burnt offerings'), influenced by altus 'high'; it is a place, not a change. Alternation is a real relative, but through alternus 'by turns', and it means taking turns, not becoming different.
items.cn: altar 来自拉丁语 altare（也许原指“燔祭”），并受 altus“高”影响；它是一个场所，不是一种改变。alternation 确实是亲戚，但经由 alternus“轮流”，意思是“交替”，不是“变得不同”。

note.en: The first group is built from the traps that surround this word: its own base verb, a near-homophone from another root, and two same-family nouns that mean turning, not changing. The second group compares words for change by how large, deliberate, corrective, or formal the change is.
note.cn: 第一组围绕这个词的陷阱展开：它自己的基础动词、另一个词根的近音词，以及两个同族但表示“轮换”而非“改变”的名词。第二组按变化的幅度、故意程度、修正性和正式程度比较几个“改变”词。

entries.definition: to change something in part. It is the verb behind alteration, and it keeps the sense of moving a thing toward its other state.
entries.definitionCN: 部分地改变某物。它是 alteration 背后的动词，保留着“把事物移向它的另一个状态”的意思。

entries.definition: a raised table for sacrifice or worship. It comes from Latin altare, influenced by altus 'high', and has no connection with alter or with change.
entries.definitionCN: 用于献祭或礼拜的高台。它来自拉丁语 altare，并受 altus“高”影响，与 alter 或“改变”毫无关系。

entries.definition: the process of two things following one another by turns, as night and day. It comes through alternus 'by turns' and means rotation, not transformation.
entries.definitionCN: 两件事依次轮流的过程，如昼夜交替。它经由 alternus“轮流”而来，意思是轮换，而不是转变。

entries.definition: a noisy dispute. It comes from Latin altercari 'to dispute', generally connected with alter 'other': two sides trade words as one 'other' against the other, without changing any object.
entries.definitionCN: 吵闹的争执。它来自拉丁语 altercari“争执”，与 alter“另一个”相关：双方作为彼此的“另一个”交换言辞，并不改变任何对象。

entries.definition: the widest term for anything becoming different, including complete replacement. Alteration is narrower: the thing stays identifiable through the change.
entries.definitionCN: 表示任何事物变得不同的最宽泛的词，包括彻底替换。alteration 更窄：事物在改变过程中仍保持可辨识。

entries.definition: a deliberate, usually small change made to improve or adapt something. It implies a purpose and a design behind the change.
entries.definitionCN: 为改进或适配某物而故意做出的、通常较小的改变。它暗示改动背后有目的与设计。

entries.definition: a small change made so that something fits, aligns, or works properly. It is corrective and often precise, unlike alteration, which can be arbitrary.
entries.definitionCN: 为使某物契合、对齐或正常运转而作的小改动。它具有修正性且常常精确，而 alteration 可以是任意的。

entries.definition: a formal change to a text, law, or contract, made through a defined procedure. It is institutional, while alteration can be informal or even unauthorized.
entries.definitionCN: 通过既定程序对文本、法律或合同作的正式修改。它是制度性的，而 alteration 可以是非正式的，甚至未经授权的。

normalIntro.en: Real pieces: alter 'the other of two', the -ation action noun, the altar trap, the alternation contrast, and the domain collocations that split the technical senses.
normalIntro.cn: 真实成分：alter“两者中的另一个”、-ation 动作名词、altar 陷阱、alternation 对照，以及拆分技术义项的领域搭配。

normal.en: alter means 'the other of two': to alter is to move a thing toward its other state, so alteration is a crossing, not an addition.
normal.cn: alter 意为“两者中的另一个”：改动就是把事物移向它的另一个状态，所以 alteration 是一次跨越，不是一次添加。

normal.en: -ation names both the act and its result, which is why alteration can be 'the changing' and 'the changed feature'.
normal.cn: -ation 同时命名动作和结果，所以 alteration 既可以指“改”这件事，也可以指“被改出来的那处不同”。

normal.en: The near-homophone altar comes from altare and altus 'high'; a raised table is not a change.
normal.cn: 近音词 altar 来自 altare 与 altus“高”；一张高起的台子不是一种改变。

normal.en: Alternation is a relative but means taking turns, like night and day; alteration means becoming other, like a renovated house.
normal.cn: alternation 是亲戚，但意思是轮流，如昼夜；alteration 意思是变成另一个样子，如翻修过的房子。

normal.en: Collocations mark the domains: structural alteration, clothing alterations, genetic alteration, material alteration.
normal.cn: 搭配标记领域：结构改造、服装改做、基因改变、实质性变更。

abstract.en: Same person, new coat: the outline and colour change, the identity does not. That is alteration rather than replacement.
abstract.cn: 同一个人，换了外套：轮廓与颜色变了，身份没变。这就是 alteration，而不是替换。

abstract.en: A house with a new doorway is still the same address; a house torn down is not. The word lives in that difference.
abstract.cn: 加了一道门的房子还是同一个地址；被拆掉的房子就不是了。这个词就活在这个差别里。

abstract.en: Rock heated by hot water keeps its shape and loses its old minerals; change can happen in place, without anything being added.
abstract.cn: 被热水加热的岩石保持形状，却失去了旧矿物；改变可以在原地发生，不需要添加任何东西。

examples.en: The landlord's consent is required for any alteration to the façade.
examples.cn: 对临街立面作任何改动都需要房东同意。

examples.en: She spent more on alterations than on the dress.
examples.cn: 她花在改衣服上的钱比买裙子还多。

examples.en: Hot water circulating through the basalt caused a slow alteration of its minerals.
examples.cn: 循环穿过玄武岩的热水使其矿物发生了缓慢的蚀变。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥特」——奥特曼换了另一套装甲，还是同一个英雄，只是样子改了 → alteration 改变；改动（只借音，不表词源）

root: 拉丁 alter「两者中的另一个」→ 晚期拉丁 alterare「使变成另一个样子」→ alteratio「改变」；核心是「变成另一个版本」，不是「往上添加」。与 altar（祭坛，拉丁 altare，受 altus「高」影响）同音形近但不同源。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of alteration all describe one thing moving toward its other version while remaining itself. The differences come from what is being changed and how much change is allowed: a coat, a building, a ledger, a cell, a rock, a legal instrument, a note.
sensesIntro.cn: alteration 的九个义项都在描述同一件事：一个东西朝着它的另一个版本移动，同时仍是它自己。差别来自被改的是什么，以及允许改到什么程度：外套、建筑、账本、细胞、岩石、法律文书、音符。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same thing wearing its other version, still recognisable.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一个东西换上了它的另一个版本，仍可辨认。

branches.en: THE GENERAL PAIR: the act of crossing to the other state, and the marks that crossing leaves on the thing.
branches.cn: 一般性的一对：跨向另一个状态的动作，以及这次跨越在事物身上留下的痕迹。

branches.en: MADE OBJECTS: a coat let out at the waist and a house with a new doorway both survive as themselves, which is what makes the change an alteration.
branches.cn: 制成品：腰身放大的外套和加了新门的房子都作为自身继续存在，这正是这种改变被称为 alteration 的原因。

branches.en: RECORDS AND VALIDITY: an altered ledger leaves a provable trace, and law decides at what point that trace becomes a material alteration.
branches.cn: 记录与效力：被改的账本留下可证明的痕迹，而法律判定这条痕迹到哪一点成为实质性变更。

branches.en: NATURAL BODIES: tissue and rock change in place; the organ or the rock body stays identifiable while its chemistry or minerals are reworked.
branches.cn: 自然体：组织与岩石在原地改变；器官或岩体保持可辨识，而其化学或矿物被重新改造。

branches.en: MUSIC: a note is moved to a neighbouring pitch but remains the same degree, the smallest possible version of the same picture.
branches.cn: 音乐：一个音被移到相邻音高，却仍是同一音级，这是同一画面最小尺度的版本。

intro.en: Alteration is a Latin action noun borrowed whole, not built in English. The chain alter → alterare → alteratio → -ation shows the suffix doing its normal job, but the interesting part is alter: a comparative word meaning 'the other of two', which is why the noun implies a paired before and after rather than simple addition.
intro.cn: alteration 是整体借入的拉丁动作名词，不是在英语里造的。链条 alter → alterare → alteratio → -ation 显示后缀在做它常规的工作，但真正有意思的是 alter：一个意为“两者中的另一个”的比较级词，这解释了为什么这个名词暗示成对的“之前／之后”，而不是简单添加。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is alter 'the other of two', alterare 'to make other, change', and alteratio 'a changing', with the action suffix -atio. The same alter also underlies alternative and alternation, but through different formations and with different modern meanings.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁层包括 alter“两者中的另一个”、alterare“使成为另一个、改变”、alteratio“改变”，以及动作后缀 -atio。同一个 alter 也是 alternative 与 alternation 的基础，但构词路径不同，现代意义也不同。

items.meaning: the act or result of changing something in part
items.meaningCN: 部分改变某物的动作或结果（-ation 动作名词）
items.example: The alteration to the will was dated and signed.
items.exampleCN: 遗嘱上的这处改动注明了日期并签了名。

items.structure: Latin alter (the other of two), via Old French alterer
items.meaningCN: 部分地改变；改动（经由古法语 alterer）
items.example: They altered the design after the first test.
items.exampleCN: 第一次测试后他们改动了设计。

items.meaning: changed, no longer in the original state
items.meaningCN: 被改变的；不再处于原状的（-ed 分词形容词）
items.example: The altered photograph no longer matched the negative.
items.exampleCN: 被改过的照片与底片已经对不上了。

items.example: The schedule is alterable until the deposit is paid.
items.exampleCN: 在付定金之前，日程是可以改的。

items.meaningCN: 不可改变的（in- 否定 + alterable）
items.example: The treaty's core article is inalterable.
items.exampleCN: 条约的核心条款不可更改。

items.meaning: offering the other of two choices
items.meaningCN: 提供两者中另一选择的；替代的（同出 alter）
items.example: They chose the alternative route through the pass.
items.exampleCN: 他们选择了翻山的另一条路线。

items.meaningCN: 轮流；交替（同族，但不是“改变”）
items.example: The alternation of wet and dry seasons drives the cycle.
items.exampleCN: 干湿季的交替驱动着这个周期。

items.meaning: a raised table for sacrifice; a different root
items.meaningCN: 祭坛；高起的献祭台（不同词根，形近陷阱）
items.example: A stone altar stood at the east end of the chapel.
items.exampleCN: 小教堂东端立着一座石祭坛。

items.meaningCN: 争吵；口角（同出 alter，但指双方争执）
items.example: The altercation began over a parking space.
items.exampleCN: 这场争吵因一个车位而起。

items.structure: French altruisme, from autrui 'other people', from Latin alteri 'others'
items.meaning: concern for the well-being of others
items.meaningCN: 利他主义；关心他人福祉（经由法语，源自拉丁 alteri“他人”）
items.example: Altruism can be described as putting the other first.
items.exampleCN: 利他主义可以描述为把他人放在前面。

definition_zh: 交替；轮流；使交替发生（形容词：交替的；间隔的；备选的）
definition_en: to take place by turns, or (of things) occurring by turns; every other one; a substitute
core_image: 左右脚一步一步轮流落地
scene: 红灯绿灯按节奏轮流亮起。Red and green lights alternate at the crossing.
sceneCN: 这里的 alternate 是「交替」（第 1 个义项：按次序轮流出现）；句意是路口的红绿灯轮流亮起。

derivatives.zh: 由 alternate 加 -ion 构成，义为「交替；轮换」
现在分词形容词，义为「交替的」
同根词，义为「选择；可选的」，侧重「替代选项」
由 alternate 加 -ly 构成，义为「交替地」

senses.title: To occur by turns
senses.definition: to happen one after the other in a repeating two-part pattern
senses.definitionCN: 以两部分重复的次序先后发生
senses.example: Days of rain alternated with bright mornings.
senses.exampleCN: 雨天与晴朗的早晨交替出现。
senses.why: The Latin alternus means "one after the other": two things taking turns.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 alternus 意为「一个接一个」：两物轮换。

senses.title: To cause to take turns
senses.definition: to arrange for two things or people to follow each other in turn
senses.definitionCN: 安排两事物或两人依次轮换
senses.example: The coach alternated the two goalkeepers.
senses.exampleCN: 教练让两名门将轮换上场。
senses.why: The transitive use arranges the same taking of turns.
senses.whyCN: 及物用法就是安排这种轮换。

senses.title: Occurring every other one
senses.definition: happening on every second occasion, skipping one
senses.definitionCN: 每两次发生一次，跳过一次
senses.example: The market is open on alternate Saturdays.
senses.exampleCN: 市场每隔一个周六开市。
senses.why: With only two slots, taking turns means every other one.
senses.whyCN: 只有两个位置时，轮换就意味着每隔一个。

senses.title: Placed one after the other
senses.definition: of things in a row, following one another in a repeating pattern
senses.definitionCN: 一列事物按重复模式依次排列
senses.example: Alternate stripes of black and white.
senses.exampleCN: 黑白相间的条纹。
senses.why: The turn-taking pattern frozen into an arrangement.
senses.whyCN: 轮换模式凝固成排列方式。

senses.title: Serving as a substitute
senses.definition: available or used in place of the usual one
senses.definitionCN: 可替代通常事物或供其代替使用的
senses.example: They found an alternate route around the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 他们找到一条绕过洪水的替代路线。
senses.why: The one who takes the other turn is the substitute.
senses.whyCN: 轮到另一次的那个就是替代者。

senses.title: A person who substitutes
senses.definition: a person ready to act in place of another, as an alternate delegate
senses.definitionCN: 准备顶替他人的人，如候补代表
senses.example: She attended the board as an alternate.
senses.exampleCN: 她以候补身份参加了董事会。
senses.why: The substitute sense becomes a noun for the person.
senses.whyCN: 替代义转为指人的名词。

senses.title: Reciprocal or mutual action
senses.definition: of actions exchanged back and forth between two parties
senses.definitionCN: 两方之间往复交换的动作
senses.example: The negotiators alternate offers and rebuttals.
senses.exampleCN: 谈判者轮流出价与反驳。
senses.why: Taking turns implies exchange; the turn returns.
senses.whyCN: 轮换暗含交换：这一轮还会回来。

senses.title: Alternating current sense
senses.definition: of electric current, reversing direction periodically, as in alternating current
senses.definitionCN: 指电流周期性反向，如交流电
senses.example: Household power is alternating current.
senses.exampleCN: 家用电是交流电。
senses.why: The turn-taking pattern applied to the direction of flow.
senses.whyCN: 轮换模式应用于电流方向。

intro.en: Alternate comes from Latin alternare, "to do by turns", from alternus "one after the other".
intro.cn: alternate 源自拉丁语 alternare「轮换着做」，来自 alternus「一个接一个」。

items.en: Root *al-, "beyond, other", the same root behind alias and alien.
items.cn: 重构词根 *al-「另一、其他」，也是 alias、alien 的词根。

items.en: alter "the other of two" → alternus "by turns" → alternare "to alternate".
items.cn: 拉丁语 alter「两者中的另一个」→ alternus「轮流的」→ alternare「交替」。

items.en: alternare used in ecclesiastical and legal Latin.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 alternare 用于教会与法律拉丁语。

items.en: alterner, the learned borrowing channel.
items.cn: 古法语 alterner，学术借入通道。

items.en: alternate adopted as verb and adjective.
items.cn: alternate 以动词与形容词进入英语。

items.en: Verb stress on -nate; adjective stress fronted; a noun sense for substitutes.
items.cn: 动词重音在 -nate，形容词重音前移，另有指候补者的名词义。

note.en: Alternate and alternative are siblings from alter with divided jobs, and alternate alternates with itself in pronunciation.
note.cn: alternate 与 alternative 是 alter 的孪生词、分工不同；alternate 一词本身兼有两种发音。

entries.definition: a choice or option; the sibling word now preferred for "substitute" in American usage.
entries.definitionCN: 选择、选项；表示「替代」时美式用法更倾向此词。

entries.definition: to change; the base verb of the family.
entries.definitionCN: 改变；词族的基干动词。

entries.definition: a dispute; "othering" each other in argument.
entries.definitionCN: 争执；在争论中互为「对方」。

entries.definition: to take turns in a cycle, often of more than two.
entries.definitionCN: 轮换，常指多于两者。

entries.definition: to give back in return; the exchange side of alternation.
entries.definitionCN: 回报；交替中的交换面。

entries.definition: to switch places or exchange repeatedly.
entries.definitionCN: 反复互换。

normalIntro.en: Remember alternate as alter's turn-taking twin.
normalIntro.cn: 把 alternate 记成 alter 的「轮换」孪生词。

normal.en: alter "the other of two" + -nate: taking the other turn.
normal.cn: alter「两者中的另一个」+ -nate：轮到另一次。

normal.en: Pronunciation: verb al-ter-NAYT, adjective AL-ter-nit.
normal.cn: 发音：动词 al-ter-NAYT，形容词 AL-ter-nit。

normal.en: Family: alter, alteration, alternative, altercation, alternation.
normal.cn: 词族：alter、alteration、alternative、altercation、alternation。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: alternating current, alternate days, alternate route.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：alternating current、alternate days、alternate route。

normal.en: Picture walking: left, right, left, right — the feet alternate.
normal.cn: 画面：走路时左右脚轮流—— feet alternate。

abstract.en: A seesaw tilting left, right, left.
abstract.cn: 跷跷板左、右、左地倾斜。

abstract.en: Two chat bubbles appearing one after the other.
abstract.cn: 两个聊天气泡一先一后出现。

abstract.en: A chess clock slapped in turn by two players.
abstract.cn: 两位棋手轮流拍按棋钟。

examples.en: The two hosts alternate each week.
examples.cn: 两位主持人每周轮换。

examples.en: Take an alternate road to avoid the jam.
examples.cn: 换条替代路线避开拥堵。

examples.en: Hope and fear alternated in her letters.
examples.cn: 希望与恐惧在她的信中交替出现。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥特内特」——奥特（alter）是“另一个”，内特（-nate）是“轮到”，另一个轮到就是交替。

root: 拉丁语 alter「两者中的另一个」（印欧词根 *al-「其他」）派生 alternus「轮流的」、动词 alternare「交替」，经古法语 alterner 于十五六世纪进入英语；同根词 alternative、altercation、altruist。

sensesIntro.en: From two things taking turns, the senses cover causing turns, skipping every other, alternating arrangements, substitutes for things and people, reciprocal exchange, and periodic reversal in current.
sensesIntro.cn: 从两物轮换出发，义项覆盖使轮换、每隔一次、相间排列、物与人的替代、往复交换，以及电流的周期反向。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two of a kind taking turns
core.cn: 核心意象：同类两者轮流登场

branches.en: Turns occurring and being arranged.
branches.cn: 轮换的发生与安排。

branches.en: Every-other occurrence and alternating arrangement.
branches.cn: 间隔发生与相间排列。

branches.en: Substitutes, whether things or persons.
branches.cn: 物或人的替代。

branches.en: Back-and-forth exchange.
branches.cn: 往复交换。

branches.en: Periodic reversal, as in alternating current.
branches.cn: 周期反向，如交流电。

intro.en: Alternate is built on alter with Latin verb endings.
intro.cn: alternate 以 alter 为基干加拉丁动词词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: The whole family descends from one small Latin word meaning "the other".
latinIntro.cn: 整个词族都源于一个意为「另一个」的拉丁小词。

definition_zh: 可供替代的；非传统的；替代方案；选择
definition_en: another possibility instead of the usual one, or a choice between two or more things
core_image: 岔路口立着两块路牌，一块指向老路，一块指向新路
scene: 医生建议先休息，如果还疼再考虑别的方案，比如物理治疗。The doctor suggested an alternative treatment.
sceneCN: 这里 alternative 是「可供替代的」（第 1 个义项：在常规办法之外另有一种可选做法）；句意是医生建议了一种替代疗法。

pos.zh: 形容词：可供替代的；非传统的

derivatives.zh: 副词：或者；作为另一种选择
动词：交替；轮流
动词：改变，与 alternative 同源
名词：交替

senses.title: Another possible choice
senses.titleCN: 可供替代的；另一可选的
senses.definition: available as another possibility in place of the usual or first one
senses.definitionCN: 作为常规或首选之外的另一可能而存在
senses.example: We need an alternative route because the bridge is closed.
senses.exampleCN: 桥封了，我们需要另一条路线。
senses.why: The Latin base alter means 'the other of two', and -native makes an adjective of offering, so alternative describes what stands ready as the other choice.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词基 alter 意为「两者中的另一个」，-native 构成表示「提供」的形容词，所以 alternative 指作为另一个选择随时可用的方案。

senses.title: Outside the mainstream
senses.definition: deliberately different from the dominant or conventional system, as in alternative medicine or energy
senses.definitionCN: 有意区别于主流或传统体系，如替代医学、替代能源
senses.example: Some patients turn to alternative medicine when drugs fail.
senses.exampleCN: 有些病人在药物无效时转向替代疗法。
senses.why: Twentieth-century counterculture gave the word a second edge: the alternative is not merely another option but a rejection of the established one.
senses.whyCN: 二十世纪的反主流文化给这个词添了第二层锋芒：alternative 不只是另一个选项，还带有对既定做法的拒绝。

senses.title: A choice to be made
senses.definition: one of two or more things that can be chosen, especially when the first is unsatisfactory
senses.definitionCN: 两个或多个可选事物之一，尤指首选不理想时的备选
senses.example: The committee saw no alternative but to cancel the event.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会别无选择，只能取消活动。
senses.why: As a noun the word names the second path itself, and the common phrase no alternative shows how it carries the weight of a forced decision.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时，这个词指第二条路本身，常见说法 no alternative 正体现它承载着「被迫决断」的分量。

intro.en: Alternative is built on the Latin idea of 'the other of two', later widened to any option and finally to anti-mainstream choices.
intro.cn: alternative 建立在拉丁语「两者中的另一个」之上，后来扩为任何选项，最终又指反主流的选择。

items.en: alter meant 'the other of two', the root also seen in alter ego.
items.cn: alter 意为「两者中的另一个」，也见于 alter ego。

items.en: alternare meant 'to do one thing then the other, to alternate'.
items.cn: alternare 意为「轮流做一件事和另一件事」。

items.en: French formed alternatif for a choice that offers one thing or the other.
items.cn: 法语构成 alternatif，指非此即彼的选择。

items.en: English alternative first described a choice between two possibilities.
items.cn: 英语 alternative 最初描述两种可能之间的取舍。

items.en: The modern sense of alternative energy or medicine marks a deliberate move away from the mainstream.
items.cn: 二十世纪出现的 alternative energy、alternative medicine 表示有意离开主流。

note.en: The look-alike group separates alter, alternate, and alternative; the near-meaning group names kinds of options.
note.cn: 形近组区分 alter、alternate 与 alternative；近义组列出各类选项。

entries.definition: happening in turn or every other one
entries.definitionCN: 交替的；间隔的

entries.definition: to change partially
entries.definitionCN: 部分改变

entries.definition: as another option
entries.definitionCN: 或者

entries.definition: a thing that may be chosen
entries.definitionCN: 选项

entries.definition: a person or thing used instead of another
entries.definitionCN: 替代物

entries.definition: a reserve choice used if the first fails
entries.definitionCN: 备用方案

normalIntro.en: Alter, the other of two, plus -native: the other one on offer.
normalIntro.cn: alter 指两者中的另一个，加 -native：提供出来的另一个。

normal.en: Alternative and alternate both come from alter.
normal.cn: alternative 与 alternate 都来自 alter。

normal.en: An alternative route is simply the other road.
normal.cn: alternative route 就是另一条路。

normal.en: Alternative medicine stands outside the mainstream.
normal.cn: 替代医学站在主流之外。

normal.en: No alternative means no second path.
normal.cn: no alternative 就是没有第二条路。

normal.en: Stress the second syllable: al-TER-na-tive.
normal.cn: 重音在第二个音节：al-TER-na-tive。

abstract.en: Picture two signposts at one fork.
abstract.cn: 想象岔路口的两块路牌。

abstract.en: See a second door when the first is locked.
abstract.cn: 想象第一扇门锁上时旁边还有一扇。

abstract.en: Imagine a plan B waiting in a drawer.
abstract.cn: 想象抽屉里放着备用的 B 计划。

examples.en: Cycling is a healthy alternative to driving to work.
examples.cn: 骑车上班是开车之外的健康选择。

examples.en: The council is looking for alternative sources of energy.
examples.cn: 议会正在寻找替代能源。

examples.en: We had no alternative but to wait for the next train.
examples.cn: 我们别无选择，只能等下一班火车。

dict_mnemonic.text: alter（另一个）加 -native：另出一个选项，就是替代方案。

root: 源自拉丁语 alter「两者中的另一个」及动词 alternare「轮流」，经法语 alternatif 于十六世纪进入英语，先指二者择一，二十世纪又发展出「非主流、另类」的义项。

sensesIntro.en: One idea of the other choice branches into a plain option, a mainstream rival, and the choice itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 「另一个选择」这一核心分出三支：普通的备选、与主流相抗的另类，以及选择本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two signposts at a fork in the road.
core.cn: 核心意象：岔路口的两块路牌。

branches.en: a different route when a bridge closes
branches.cn: 桥封后的另一条路线

branches.en: cycling instead of driving
branches.cn: 以骑车代替开车

branches.en: herbal treatment outside hospitals
branches.cn: 医院之外的草药疗法

branches.en: wind power as a rival to coal
branches.cn: 与煤电相争的风电

branches.en: no choice but to cancel
branches.cn: 只能取消，别无选择

intro.en: A Latin root with a French-Latin suffix, plus a cluster of look-alike forms.
intro.cn: 拉丁词根配法拉丁后缀，并带一串形近词。

latinIntro.en: The base alter and the verb alternare are both Latin, so they are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 词基 alter 与动词 alternare 都是拉丁语，列在下面。

definition_zh: 测高仪；高度计；（飞机上的）高度表
definition_en: an instrument that measures altitude, especially the height of an aircraft above a level
core_image: 驾驶舱里一格格转动的指针，告诉你离地多高
scene: 飞行员爬升时盯着表盘。The pilot checked the altimeter at ten thousand feet.
sceneCN: 这里的 altimeter 是「高度表」（第 1 个义项：测量高度的仪器）；句意是飞行员在一万英尺处查看高度表。

derivatives.zh: 同根名词，义为「高度；海拔」
由 alti- 加 -metry 构成，义为「测高术；高度测量」
同根成分，义为「测量器具；米」

senses.title: An aircraft height gauge
senses.definition: the cockpit instrument showing an aircraft's height above a reference level
senses.definitionCN: 座舱内显示飞机相对于基准面高度的仪表
senses.example: The altimeter read nine thousand feet.
senses.exampleCN: 高度表读数为九千英尺。
senses.why: Built from altus "high" plus metron "measure": the high-measurer.
senses.whyCN: 由 altus「高」加 metron「测量」构成：测量高的仪器。

senses.title: A barometric altimeter
senses.definition: an altimeter that converts air pressure into altitude
senses.definitionCN: 把气压换算成高度的测高仪
senses.example: Climbers carry a barometric altimeter uphill.
senses.exampleCN: 登山者背着气压高度计上山。
senses.why: Air thins with height, so pressure becomes a height signal.
senses.whyCN: 空气随高度变稀，气压因此成为高度信号。

senses.title: A radar or laser altimeter
senses.definition: a device measuring height by reflected radio waves or laser light
senses.definitionCN: 以反射无线电波或激光测高的装置
senses.example: The satellite's radar altimeter mapped the sea surface.
senses.exampleCN: 卫星的雷达测高仪测绘了海面。
senses.why: Timing a signal's round trip yields the distance below.
senses.whyCN: 信号往返的时间差给出下方距离。

senses.title: A surveying or scientific altimeter
senses.definition: a precision instrument for measuring elevations in field science
senses.definitionCN: 野外科学中测量海拔的精密仪器
senses.example: The team logged each site with an altimeter.
senses.exampleCN: 考察队用测高仪记录每个站点。
senses.why: Wherever height matters, a measuring instrument follows.
senses.whyCN: 凡高度要紧之处，测量仪器随之出现。

senses.title: A watch or wearable altimeter
senses.definition: an altimeter function built into watches or phones
senses.definitionCN: 集成于腕表或手机的高度计功能
senses.example: His watch has an altimeter for hiking.
senses.exampleCN: 他的手表带徒步用的高度计。
senses.why: Sensors shrink; the instrument becomes a feature.
senses.whyCN: 传感器缩小，仪器变成了功能。

senses.title: The system or discipline of height measurement
senses.definition: altimeter used broadly for a measuring system of altitude
senses.definitionCN: 泛指测量高度的系统或方法
senses.example: The probe's altimeter failed before landing.
senses.exampleCN: 探测器的测高系统在着陆前失灵。
senses.why: The word can name the whole apparatus, not just one dial.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可指整套装置，不只是一个表盘。

senses.title: Altitude data as output
senses.definition: the reading or data stream produced by an altimeter
senses.definitionCN: 测高仪产生的读数或数据流
senses.example: We lost altimeter data during the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨中我们丢失了测高数据。
senses.why: Instrument names often extend to their outputs.
senses.whyCN: 仪器名常转指其输出。

senses.title: Figurative: a gauge of level or status
senses.definition: used figuratively for anything that indicates how high or advanced something is
senses.definitionCN: 喻指显示事物高度或先进程度的标志
senses.example: Stock prices are the market's altimeter.
senses.exampleCN: 股价是市场的晴雨高度表。
senses.why: A meter of height measures success or progress by metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 测高的仪表借喻度量成就或进展。

intro.en: Altimeter joins Latin altus "high" with the Greek-derived agent suffix -meter, "measurer".
intro.cn: altimeter 由拉丁语 altus「高」与希腊来源的 -meter「测量器」复合而成。

items.en: Root *al-, "to grow, nourish", behind altus.
items.cn: altus 背后的重构词根 *al-「生长；滋养」。

items.en: altus, "high, deep".
items.cn: 拉丁语 altus「高的；深的」。

items.en: metron "measure" and metes "measurer", via -meter.
items.cn: 希腊语 metron「量度」、metes「测量者」，经 -meter 传入。

items.en: altimètre / altimeter coined with barometers in the 18th-19th century.
items.cn: 十八九世纪随气压计的运用造出 altimètre/altimeter。

items.en: English altimeter in scientific use.
items.cn: 十九世纪英语 altimeter 用于科学语境。

items.en: Standard aviation and space term since early flight.
items.cn: 航空早期以来成为标准航空与航天术语。

note.en: Altimeter pairs with altitude and altimetry from the same altus root, and resembles other -meter instruments.
note.cn: altimeter 与同根的 altitude、altimetry 配对，且与其他 -meter 仪器词形相近。

entries.definition: height itself; the quantity, not the instrument.
entries.definitionCN: 高度本身；是量值而非仪器。

entries.definition: the science of measuring altitude.
entries.definitionCN: 测高的学科。

entries.definitionCN: 测气压，气压高度表据其换算高度。

normal.en: alti- (altus "high") + -meter (measure): the high-measurer.
normal.cn: alti-（altus「高」）+ -meter（测量）：测高的仪器。

normal.en: Family: altitude (height), altimetry (science), altimeter (tool).
normal.cn: 词族：altitude（高度）、altimetry（学科）、altimeter（工具）。

normal.en: Same -meter family: speedometer, odometer, barometer.
normal.cn: 同一 -meter 家族：speedometer、odometer、barometer。

normal.en: Types: barometric, radar, laser altimeters.
normal.cn: 类型：气压式、雷达式、激光式测高仪。

normal.en: Aviation habit: set the altimeter before takeoff.
normal.cn: 航空习惯：起飞前拨定高度表。

examples.cn: 把高度表拨到机场标高。

examples.en: Her altimeter showed the summit at 6,900 meters.

examples.en: The rocket's altimeter triggered the parachute.

definition_zh: 海拔；高度；（几何中的）高
definition_en: the height of a place above sea level, height in general, or the perpendicular height of a geometric figure
core_image: 飞机舷窗外的雪山，仪表盘上标着飞行高度
scene: 飞机爬升到巡航高度后，窗外的河流变成了一条细线。The plane reached a cruising altitude of ten thousand metres.
sceneCN: 这里 altitude 是「高度」（第 2 个义项：物体离地面的垂直距离）；句意是飞机达到了一万米的巡航高度。

senses.title: Height above sea level
senses.definition: the vertical distance of a place above the level of the sea, used in geography and travel
senses.definitionCN: 某地高出海平面的垂直距离，用于地理与旅行
senses.example: The village sits at an altitude of three thousand metres.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村庄位于海拔三千米处。
senses.why: Latin altitudo came from altus, 'high', and in geography the word was fixed to the one reference line that matters, the sea.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 altitudo 来自 altus「高的」，在地理中这个词被固定到唯一重要的基准线，也就是海平面。

senses.title: Height above the ground
senses.definition: the height of an aircraft or object above the ground or a chosen level at a particular moment
senses.definitionCN: 飞机或物体在某一时刻离地面或某一基准的高度
senses.example: The plane reached a cruising altitude of ten thousand metres.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机达到了一万米的巡航高度。
senses.why: Once the word meant height in general, aviation could use it for a changing measurement rather than a fixed spot on the map.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本泛指高度，航空便用它表示不断变化的测量值，而不是地图上固定的地点。

senses.title: Perpendicular height of a figure
senses.definition: the line drawn at right angles from a vertex to the opposite side of a triangle or solid
senses.definitionCN: 从顶点垂直画到对边的线段，用于三角形或立体图形
senses.example: The area of a triangle is half the base times the altitude.
senses.exampleCN: 三角形的面积等于底乘高的一半。
senses.why: Geometry kept the pure sense of 'height' and gave it a precise meaning: the perpendicular distance from a vertex to the opposite side.
senses.whyCN: 几何学保留了「高度」的纯粹含义，并给它精确定义：从顶点到对边的垂直距离。

intro.en: Altitude descends from the Latin word for height and was later borrowed by geography, aviation, and geometry.
intro.cn: altitude 源自拉丁语表示「高度」的词，后来被地理、航空与几何分别借用。

items.en: altus meant 'high, deep', and it also underlies alto and altimeter.
items.cn: altus 意为「高的、深的」，也是 alto 与 altimeter 的来源。

items.en: altitudo was the abstract noun for height or depth.
items.cn: altitudo 是表示高度或深度的抽象名词。

items.en: French passed the word into English in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 法语在十四世纪把这个词传入英语。

items.en: Mapmakers fixed altitude to height above sea level.
items.cn: 地图绘制者把 altitude 固定为高出海平面的高度。

items.en: Flight added the sense of an aircraft's height at a given moment.
items.cn: 航空又增添了飞机在某一时刻的高度的含义。

items.en: Mathematicians used altitude for the perpendicular height of a figure.
items.cn: 数学家用 altitude 指图形的垂直高。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one syllable; the near-meaning group separates height and elevation.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个音节；近义组区分高度与海拔。

normal.cn: altitude 是垂直的，纬度和经度则铺在地球表面。

sensesIntro.en: The general idea of height is fixed to three different baselines: the sea, the ground, and a figure's opposite side.
